episodes.name: Intelligent Design
episodes.overviewEn: E.R. doctor Mark Curry dreams of a fantastical world that couldn't possibly exist, but then he learns that he's not the only one dreaming about it, and someone wants the dreamers dead.

episodes.name: Impossible History
episodes.overviewEn: As impossible memories begin surfacing around the world, Mark searches for answers and discovers that myths about ancient gods may be rooted in a hidden truth.

episodes.name: Identity Crisis
episodes.overviewEn: The awakening dreamers struggle to reconcile their ordinary lives with visions of immortal heroes, while a dangerous enemy begins hunting them one by one.

episodes.name: Hostage Situation
episodes.overviewEn: When one of the newly awakened Eternals is captured, the others must work together despite lingering doubts about their true identities and purpose.

episodes.name: Genesis
episodes.overviewEn: The origins of the Eternals, Deviants, and Celestials are finally revealed, exposing a secret history that has shaped humanity for thousands of years.

episodes.name: Revelations
episodes.overviewEn: Armed with new knowledge about their past, the Eternals begin to understand the scale of the threat gathering against them and the world.

episodes.name: Right to Life
episodes.overviewEn: As the conflict escalates, the Eternals are forced to decide whether humanity deserves protection from forces beyond its understanding.

episodes.name: Gods, Heroes and Others
episodes.overviewEn: Ancient rivalries return as the Eternals confront enemies from their distant past while struggling to define their place among humanity.

episodes.name: Modified Rapture
episodes.overviewEn: The Deviants move forward with their plans, forcing the scattered Eternals into a race against time to prevent a catastrophic transformation.

episodes.name: Journey's End
episodes.overviewEn: The Eternals unite for a final confrontation that will determine not only their own future, but the fate of humanity itself.
